items.source: The postProcessMergedBeanDefinition(RootBeanDefinition, Class, String) method may for example introspect the bean definition in order to prepare some cached metadata before post-processing actual instances of a bean. It is also allowed to modify the bean definition but only for definition properties which are actually intended for concurrent modification. Essentially, this only applies to operations defined on the RootBeanDefinition itself but not to the properties of its base classes.
items.translation: `postProcessMergedBeanDefinition(RootBeanDefinition, Class, String)` 方法可能会检查 bean 定义，以便在真正处理 bean 实例之前准备一些缓存的元数据。也可以修改 bean 定义，但仅针对那些实际上允许并发修改的定义属性。本质上，这仅适用于在 `RootBeanDefinition` 本身定义的操作，而不包括其基类的属性。

items.source: Post-process the given merged bean definition for the specified bean.
items.translation: 对指定 Bean 的合并后的 Bean 定义进行后处理。

items.source:
A notification that the bean definition for the specified name has been reset,
and that this post-processor should clear any metadata for the affected bean.
items.translation: 指定名称的 Bean 定义已被重置的通知，且此后置处理器应清除受影响 Bean 的任何元数据。

items.source: beanDefinition - the merged bean definition for the bean
items.translation: beanDefinition - 该 Bean 的合并后的 Bean 定义

items.source: beanType - the actual type of the managed bean instance
items.translation: beanType - 托管 Bean 实例的实际类型
